title: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A planeswalker from Theros, an undefeated javelin champion who wields mirror magic, rides with the Kannah and sets out for Starnheim to defy a prophecy.

entities.name: Kjell
entities.description: A Kannah mystic and cleric, auger and land-reader who mentors Niko and hides what he hears from Fynn.

entities.name: Birgi
entities.description: A storyteller who is really a goddess, with amethyst eyes and shimmering tattoos, who provokes a brawl between Kannah and Omenseekers.

entities.name: Fynn Snakehunter
entities.description: The Kannah leader who rides at the head of bear warriors with a Cosmos Serpent scale shield and fears for Starnheim.

entities.name: Orhaft Stoneback
entities.description: An Omenseeker Vedrune (rune-priest) of the Kirda Sea who uses xe/xer pronouns and agrees to send Niko to Starnheim.

entities.name: Avtyr
entities.description: A black-winged male Valkyrie reaper trapped by Niko in a mirror shard.

entities.name: Gray-winged Valkyrie
entities.description: Avtyr's dove-gray-winged counterpart who watches from a roof.

entities.name: Threat
entities.description: A large gray cat belonging to Jutmaw or a boat that plays with Niko's mirrors.

entities.name: Steel-eyes
entities.description: An Omenseeker sailor who insults the Kannah and starts the brawl.

entities.name: Sweet-face
entities.description: An Omenseeker who questions whether Fynn can prove what he claims.

entities.name: Thura Sail-Rend
entities.description: A legendary warrior in Birgi's tale who killed her kin-killing brother and earned a place in Starnheim.

entities.name: Kinkiller
entities.description: Thura Sail-Rend's once-brother and betrayer, who is sent to Istfell.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The Cosmos Serpent, linked to Fynn, caged by the gods and a threat to break free and swallow the light of Starnheim.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: The god of wisdom, said to travel in disguise.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: A Theran goddess of wisdom whom Niko compares to Alrund.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: A Theran god of epiphanies in Akros.

entities.name: Tergrid
entities.description: A goddess of nightmares and shadows invoked in an oath.

entities.name: Egil Seventree
entities.description: The hero of a Kaldheim saga Kjell offers to teach.

entities.name: Kannah
entities.description: A clan of bear riders cursed by winter whenever they leave their forest.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: A clan of sailors tattooed with blue circular patterns.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: Winged beings who fly in pairs and attend deaths, in life and in saga.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: The gods of Kaldheim who caged the Cosmos Serpent.

entities.name: Jutmaw
entities.description: A neutral outpost between sea and forest with a longhouse, built and burned many times.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The paradise realm of the Valkyries and the gods, which no living mortal has entered.

entities.name: Istfell
entities.description: The afterlife of traitors.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The tree linking Kaldheim's realms; Kjell says Theros is a lost branch.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: The realm where Jutmaw lies.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Niko's home plane, thought by Kjell to be a lost realm of Kaldheim.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The Viking plane of nine realms.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Random ways between worlds that open and close; many at once signal a Doomskar.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: A clash of realms ripping each other open.

entities.name: Frith
entities.description: The Kaldheim tradition of guest-rights, peace or truce.

events.summary: At the Jutmaw longhall Niko wins a stone-skipping bet, earning peace-gift armor.
events.quote: wearing their winnings—a mismatched assortment of the peace gifts exchanged between the Kannah and Omenseekers

events.summary: Kjell explains the Kannah curse of winter and frith, and Niko wonders about gods who visit in disguise.
events.quote: Whenever a Kannah left their forest, soft snows followed, then hail and thunder

events.summary: Birgi tells the saga of Thura Sail-Rend, and Niko plays with a cat using conjured mirrors.
events.quote: Thura would not escape death that day, for only death draws the attention of the Valkyries

events.summary: Birgi joins Niko and Kjell, who explains Fynn's dream that the Cosmos Serpent will break its cage and swallow the light of Starnheim.
events.quote: The Cosmos Serpent will break its cage and the first thing it swallows will be the light.

events.summary: Birgi leads Niko and Kjell outside; Omenseekers mock Fynn and the Kannah, and a brawl erupts.
events.quote: the insult died between a Kannah forehead and an Omenseeker face

events.summary: Niko realizes Birgi provoked the fight and fends off attackers with mirror traps to protect Kjell.
events.quote: Niko grabbed a shard in each hand, stretching each into a dagger

events.summary: Niko spots two Valkyries watching to see if they will finish the sailor and traps the black-winged one in a mirror shard.
events.quote: The trap hit home right between his wings, shattered the illusion of his body into a thousand mirrored shards

events.summary: Niko takes the shard to Fynn and Orhaft on the ship and asks them to stop the fight.
events.quote: They're all fighting—blades out, blood on the snow—some woman goaded them on.

events.summary: Orhaft warns that Niko's presence brings destruction, and Niko offers to be sent to Starnheim with a warning.
events.quote: If you're convinced that destruction follows me, then send me to Starnheim with a warning so they're prepared.

events.summary: Orhaft agrees to give Niko what they ask for, after Niko says they never miss.
events.quote: Return to the ship once you've said your farewells. I will give you what you ask for.

events.summary: Niko shoves Birgi, who reveals she is a goddess and says she did this so Niko may know them.
events.quote: I did this so you may know us. Our joy, our rage—how little lies between.

events.summary: Kjell reveals Fynn ordered him to watch Niko but he chose to spare them, and he urges Niko to do something crazy.
events.quote: Fynn saw you. Said you were a threat. Commanded me to keep you close.

events.summary: Niko boards the Omenseeker ship; Orhaft names the trapped Valkyrie Avtyr and vows to release him after Niko passes through.
events.quote: the black-haired, black-winged Valkyrie's name was Avtyr and that those with dark wings are called reapers

events.summary: Through an Omenpath guided by Orhaft and the Valkyrie's magic, Niko leaps onto a skiff and arrives at the docks of Starnheim.
events.quote: The skiff bumped against a vast network of docks that disappeared into the kind of light that sings of home.

relations.note: Kjell mentored Niko every step of the way.
relations.quote: had mentored Niko every step of the way
Fynn's auger addressed the Omenseeker in the dulcet tones of mockery.

relations.note: They became close friends over two weeks.
relations.quote: They had known each other two weeks, but he always knew what to say.

relations.note: Fynn rides at the head of the bear warriors.
relations.quote: He rode at the head of an avalanche of bear warriors

relations.note: Orhaft is Vedrune of the sailors' ship and one of their elders.
The two clans clash in a drunken brawl.
relations.quote: Everyone was in it now, knees to guts, elbows to throats, punching and bashing

relations.note: Birgi provokes the fight to show Niko the Kaldheim people.
Niko traps the Valkyrie to prevent a death.
relations.quote: hold the creature hurling itself against the boundaries within

relations.note: Fynn carries a scale from the Cosmos Serpent as a shield and is linked to it.
